title: Stop Claude building web apps that look AI-generated
hook: Why every AI-built website looks the same

beats.say: Why does every app I build look like the same purple gradient?

panel.text: Purple gradient. Inter font. Three cards.

beats.say: Because you asked for a clean website. So you got the average of every website.
Give Claude a design direction and ban the defaults, like a real art director would.

panel.text: Build this landing page as a 1970s Swiss transit poster. Strict grid, one typeface, black, cream and signal red. No gradients, no rounded cards, no emoji icons. Explain each design choice in one line.

beats.say: In Claude Code, add Anthropic's frontend design skill so it picks a bold direction every time.
That looks like an agency made it.
Told you. Swiss design never dies.

cta: Follow for one Claude build a day
cta_sub: Save this before your next build
caption: AI-built sites look the same because vague prompts get the average answer. Give Claude a real design reference, ban the defaults, and make it justify every choice. In Claude Code, Anthropic's frontend-design skill pushes it toward a distinct direction by default. Prompt in the first comment.
